tool.name: nf-core umicollapse
tool.description: Deduplicate reads based on the mapping co-ordinate and the UMI attached to the read.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ # Getting the umicollapse jar file like this because `umicollapse` is a Python wrapper script generated # by conda that allows to set the heap size (Xmx), but not the stack size (Xss). # `which` allows us to get the directory that contains `umicollapse`, independent of whether we # are in a container or conda environment. UMICOLLAPSE_JAR=\$(dirname \$(which umicollapse))/../share/umicollapse-${VERSION}/umicollapse.jar java \\ -Xmx${max_heap_size_mega}M \\ -Xss${max_stack_size_mega}M \\ -jar \$UMICOLLAPSE_JAR \\ $mode \\ -i ${input} \\ -o ${prefix}.${extension} \\ $args | tee ${prefix}_UMICollapse.log
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": umicollapse: $VERSION END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Deduplicate reads based on the mapping co-ordinate and the UMI attached to the read.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: umicollapse Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/umicollapse ]]>
